name: native-capability-deprecation-register
objective: إنشاء جرد evidence-bound لكل Native dependency/capability للميداني وتصنيفها دون أي حذف مادي أو تغيير fingerprint أثناء تنفيذ المنتج.
truthOwner: Actual runtime consumers + workspace peer graph + mobile capability manifest/Expo config own native requirement truth.

tasks.objective: Classify every app-field native dependency/capability with direct/shared/peer/config evidence and freeze physical removal until U014.
tasks.currentProblem: Large dependency manifest can contain unused or indirectly required packages; immediate bulk removal risks breaking current dev build and wasting limited EAS build capacity.
tasks.requiredChange: Produce/maintain a deprecation register based on imports, workspace graph, peers, autolinking, Expo plugins/permissions and runtime use; prohibit physical removal in this unit.
tasks.targetState: Every candidate has an explicit evidence-backed state and removal trigger; required packages remain; deprecated packages are frozen pending one coherent native cleanup window.
tasks.action: Inspect app-field package, mobile capability manifest/guard, Expo config, shared packages and other apps only for shared peer evidence; mark KEEP/REQUIRED_NATIVE/DEPRECATED_CANDIDATE/DEPRECATED_CONFIRMED without editing native graph.
mustNotChange: لا pnpm remove في هذه الوحدة.
acceptanceCriteria: كل dependency Native للميداني لها classification وevidence/removal trigger.
لا يتغير native fingerprint عمدًا بسبب هذه الوحدة.
لا استعمال business جديد لعناصر DEPRECATED_CONFIRMED.
tasks.rollback: Register-only unit; revert only incorrect classification while preserving native graph.
tasks.commitBoundary: Deprecation evidence/register only, no physical native cleanup.
